title: Service Properties Trust — 2024 Form 10-K
description: SEC Form 10-K (fiscal year ended Dec 31, 2024, Commission File No. 1-11527). Tailored to this specific filing.

company_name.description: Registrant name exactly as printed on the cover page.

commission_file_number.description: SEC commission file number from the cover page.

fiscal_year_end.description: Fiscal year end date printed on the cover.

ticker_symbols.description: Trading symbols registered under Section 12(b), from the cover-page securities table.

state_of_incorporation.description: State of incorporation from the cover page.

is_well_known_seasoned_issuer.description: Whether the WKSI checkbox is ticked on the cover page.

filer_category.description: Which filer-category checkbox is ticked on the cover page.

net_lease_portfolio_property_count.description: Number of service-focused retail net lease properties as of the fiscal year end, from Item 1.

net_lease_portfolio_total_square_feet.description: Aggregate square feet of the net lease portfolio as of fiscal year end.

net_lease_weighted_avg_term_years.description: Weighted average remaining lease term of the net lease portfolio in years.

hotel_brand_flags.description: Every distinct hotel brand flag listed in the Schedule III or property lists. Multi-page aggregation across the end-of-report property tables.

shareholders_equity_2024.description: Ending balance row from the Consolidated Statements of Shareholders' Equity for the most recent year shown.

had_net_loss_2024.description: Whether the company reported a net loss (vs. net income) for fiscal 2024. Derived — inspect the equity roll-forward / income statement sign.

subsidiary_entities.description: Every legal entity name listed in the Subsidiaries of the Registrant exhibit (e.g. Exhibit 21).

auditor_name.description: Independent registered public accounting firm named in the audit opinion.

auditor_pcaob_id.description: Auditor PCAOB ID number, if disclosed under the audit opinion.

avg_property_size_sqft.description: Mean square footage per net lease property, computed as total_sqft ÷ property_count (both from Item 1). Round to nearest integer.

total_equity_change_2021_to_2024_thousan.description: Difference between Total Equity at December 31, 2024 and Total Equity at December 31, 2021, from the Consolidated Statements of Shareholders’ Equity. Signed (can be negative). In thousands of dollars.

years_reporting_net_loss_vs_income.description: For each fiscal year shown in the Shareholders’ Equity roll-forward, whether the company reported net loss (negative) or net income (positive).

subsidiary_count_with_hpt_prefix.description: Number of subsidiaries in the Subsidiaries-of-Registrant exhibit whose legal name starts with 'HPT '. Requires scanning the full list.

sonesta_brand_property_count.description: Count of hotel properties at the end of the report whose brand column contains 'Sonesta' (any Sonesta variant). Aggregates across the end-of-report property list.

qualified_audit_opinion.description: Whether the independent auditor's opinion contains qualifying language (e.g. 'except for', 'going concern', 'material weakness'). Null if the opinion is not present in the truncated filing.

mentions_bankruptcy_or_going_concern.description: Whether Item 1A Risk Factors or the Notes to Financial Statements explicitly mention bankruptcy risk or going-concern. Tests aggregation + classification of risk language across multiple sections.

reit_dividend_distribution_requirement_p.description: The minimum-distribution percentage of taxable income a REIT must pay to shareholders, as disclosed in the tax-treatment section. ADVERSARIAL-LEANING: may not be explicitly printed as a single number; null if absent.

cover_page_registered_securities.description: Every row of the cover-page 'Securities registered pursuant to Section 12(b)' table: title of class, trading symbol, exchange name. Tests row-level KV binding on the cover-page table.

filer_category_checkboxes.description: Cover-page filer-category checkbox set — which boxes are ticked. Tests reading every checkbox, not just the one ticked.

cover_page_yes_no_checkboxes.description: Cover-page yes/no checkbox matrix: is WKSI? filed all reports under 13/15(d)? filed submitting interactive data? shell company? Tests dense cover-page form region — multiple boolean rows.

equity_rollforward_2024_row_reconciliati.description: For fiscal 2024 row of the Consolidated Statements of Shareholders’ Equity, extract all the mid-row movements that reconcile opening to closing equity: net_income_loss, distributions, other_comp_income. Tests KV binding across a wide multi-column table row.

commission_file_header_fields.description: Cover-page 'Registrant' header block: exact Name of Registrant, IRS Employer Identification Number, state or other jurisdiction of incorporation, address of principal executive offices with zip. Tests dense cover-page key-value form region.
